name: Adaptive Guidance guider with uncond-zero (asagi4 pack, patched here)
plain: Measures cosine similarity of cond and uncond and turns CFG off for the rest of the run after it passes a threshold. In the CFG-off steps it can apply an uncond-zero style output. The patched copy on this box uses the least-converged image in a batch.
math:
sim = per-image cos(x̂_c,x̂_u); if min sim ≥ thr: remember timestep
ts>start or past remembered timestep or cfg=1: x̂ = x̂_c, or with uz_scale>0: x̂ = x − (c/√std(c))·uz, c = x−x̂_c
else CFG
label: from code
